dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical linear narrowing from the widest mid-body point toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; median intensity is high across the primary dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low density; localized grey-blue pigmentation observed on the anterior melon and along the left posterior lateral margin.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse; soft gradient transitions between the depigmented white canvas and the darker pigmented regions.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A distinct dark circular point at the blowhole; multiple fine-scale white specular highlights distributed across the central dorsal surface.
